# JC-AUDITOR-ARCHITECT-v1 Blueprint
This repository is undergoing a transformation towards the Swiss High-End Light Mode Design System.
- **Framework:** Next.js 16+, React 19.2+, TypeScript 5.5+
- **UI Engine:** Tailwind CSS v4 with OKLCH Color Space
- **Directives:** No new routes are created. All existing routes will be expanded with >800 words of technical content and 1 interactive module.
